subject: Bash syntax diagnostic for pinned P2 EGM runner
body: Read-only parse diagnostic for 41088c P2 runner, no EGM model invocation or code writes.

argv:
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,tempfile,pathlib,os
repo=os.environ.get('DORE_REPO_ROOT') or os.getcwd()
rev='41088c777428f532c0dd154e710a2f89654be3f9'
r=subprocess.run(['git','show',rev+':scripts/p2-egm-a2a-review.sh'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True)
if r.returncode: raise SystemExit('SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE '+r.stderr[-250:])
s=r.stdout
a=s.index('# EGM is pinned on its companion Design OS PR')
b=s.index('TASK_PROMPT=',a)
cases={
 'full':s,
 'without_entire_insert':s[:a]+s[b:],
 'only_pin_record':s[:a]+'git ls-tree "refs/remotes/origin/$EGM_BRANCH" -- .tools/elephant-goldfish-model > "$PROOF/egm-source-authority.txt"\n'+s[b:],
 'without_apostrophe':s.replace("EGM's source pin","EGM source pin"),
 'without_printf':s.replace("printf 'EGM integration branch: %s; P2 remains separate.\\n' \"$EGM_BRANCH\" >> \"$PROOF/egm-source-authority.txt\"",""),
 'original_prefix_only':s[:a]+s[b:].replace("EGM's source pin","EGM source pin"),
}
for name,code in cases.items():
 with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w',suffix='.sh',delete=False) as f:
  f.write(code);path=f.name
 out=subprocess.run(['bash','-n',path],capture_output=True,text=True)
 print(name,'exit',out.returncode,'error',out.stderr[-380:].strip().replace('\n',' | '))
 pathlib.Path(path).unlink()
print('N_LINES',len(s.splitlines()),'SOURCE_BYTES',len(s))
PY
